host_threads.policy: Pin OMP/MKL to six allocated CPUs for this repeated timing run.
host_threads.comparison_scope: Keep prior unpinned 1k smoke diagnostic; use consistently pinned threads for repeated cost curves.
host_threads.causal_claim: This operational pin is not established as a fix for previous startup slowness.

stability.summary: All three repetitions and first-use spread remain. Median/min/max describe technical repeats, not confidence intervals.

semantics.ordinary_tps: Synchronized native loop rates include eviction/output processing; scheduling/reset/verification outside the loop remain excluded.
semantics.selection_compaction: Whole instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay totals, nested in inference; not per-token rates or costs to add again.
semantics.warmup: Unchanged source312 standard synthetic warmup; no additional per-shape warmup. First repetition is not guaranteed cold because preceding work and persistent caches can prime execution.
semantics.memory: Prefill occupancy uses 4096 logical cached tokens; decode occupancy uses 4160. Prefill and ordinary-decode peaks have explicit separate boundaries; reserved pool and total VRAM are distinct.
semantics.comparability: This 64-decode/three-repeat version is separate from 8-decode feasibility and old unpinned 1k smoke.

interpretation: Full/R-KV/AgentKV ordinary decode rates differ by less than 0.33 percent across all three repeats. This is descriptive stability for one history and node.
StreamingLLM 80/50 percent first repeats remain slower. All three points remain in summaries and figures; no instrumented rate replaces ordinary throughput.

Ordinary R-KV 80 percent decode reserved 36.465 GiB with sampled total peak 36.812 GiB in every repetition, versus allocated peak 21.664 GiB. This capacity-relevant reservation is preserved separately from prefill peaks and KV occupancy.
The predeclared central 50 percent cross-method view is accompanied by all-retention supplements, including decode peaks that expose the 80 percent memory finding.
Two measured lengths are connected without smoothing or fitting. First repetitions remain visible. This is not model accuracy, task-success or recovery-quality evidence.

allocator_reservation_observation.per_pass_reset: Pinned native.start empties allocator cache and resets peak counters on each pass; the high reservation is not simply leftover cache from the preceding method.
allocator_reservation_observation.interpretation: The process reserved substantially more memory than its allocated tensor peak, under the unchanged cap. Kernel/fragmentation cause is not established. Reserved KV pool is a separate 4.50014 GiB quantity.

paired_figures.decode_peak_boundary: Whole ordinary prefix-plus-continuation decode pass; includes allocator reservation, not KV occupancy.
